title: 第8章 人情
novel_title: 长生：我体内有一片坟陵
content_zh:
五道纹筑基丹！

    苏牧目光一闪，颇为意外。

    筑基丹是修行界非常重要的丹药之一，是炼气修士梦寐以求的东西。

    而丹药又以纯净程度划分多个品阶，各品阶之间价格差异很大。

    以筑基丹为例。

    一道纹为下品，市场价格固定为五千块下品灵石，对辅助提升筑基的效果极其有限，而且丹毒较重，若是失败，轻则经脉受损，重则直接修为被废乃至身死道消。

    所以，一道纹筑基丹被戏称为“赌命丹”，不到山穷水尽绝望的地步，没有哪个修士会轻易使用。

    即便如此，五千块下品灵石的高价，也让众多普通修士望而却步，穷极一生都可能积攒不到。

    二道纹至四道纹为中品，市场价格浮动比较大，一般在两万至五万下品灵石区间，能提升三到六成的筑基概率，在修行界使用最为广泛。

    五道纹和六道纹为上品，市价十万起步，辅助筑基的效果在七成以上概率，却比较少见，尤其是六道纹，有价无市，通常出现在拍卖会上。

    至于七道纹以上的极品丹药，在整个燕国修行界估计都是绝迹的存在。

    反正苏牧没听说过，更没见过，哪怕是最低级的入门丹药，最高品质也不过六道纹。

    由此可见，一枚五道纹的筑基丹，对他的吸引力有多大。

    除此之外，齐子濯一个活了两百多岁的老辈筑基修士，积攒的家底定然不菲。

    只是，其中隐患也很多。

    譬如筑基丹，他怕自己有命拿没命用。

    与齐云溪结为道侣，在旁人眼里，几乎等于将“我有筑基丹”刻在脸上，妥妥的怀璧其罪，遭人惦记。

    以他目前炼气六层的修为，根本把握不住。

    心中一番计较，苏牧看去对面，正要开口再次拒绝。

    一直观察他表情变化的齐子濯，却是先一步传音道：“你放心，这枚五道纹筑基丹乃机缘所得，外人不知，我另外为你和溪儿备了两枚三道纹，被人找上门，给出去便是。”

    苏牧对上殷切期盼的目光，想到对方这些年对自己的诸般照顾，眼下行将就木，一再恳求，一时间心中不忍，纠结无比。

    齐子濯呵呵一笑，继续道：“老夫活了这么一把岁数，在宗门也有几个信得过朋友，自会相请关照你，你无需过多顾虑。”

    苏牧犹豫片刻，因为神识不足无法传音，身子微微前倾，压低声音道：“恕弟子冒犯，敢问齐长老，您大概还有多少寿元？”
content_en:
Five patterns of foundation elixir!

    Su Mu's eyes flashed, quite surprised.

    Foundation Building Pill is one of the most important pills in the world of cultivation, and it is something that Qi Refining monks dream of.

    The elixirs are divided into multiple grades based on their purity, and the prices vary greatly between each grade.

    Take the Foundation Building Pill as an example.

    One line is a low-grade stone, and the market price is fixed at 5,000 low-grade spiritual stones. Its effect on assisting in improving the foundation is extremely limited, and the erysipelas is relatively heavy. If it fails, the meridians will be damaged at the least, and the cultivation will be directly abolished or even the body will die.

    Therefore, a pattern-building foundation pill is jokingly called the "Life Gambling Pill". No monk will use it easily unless he is at the end of his rope and desperate.

    Even so, the high price of 5,000 yuan of low-grade spiritual stones has kept many ordinary monks away, and they may not be able to accumulate it in their lifetime.

    Second to fourth lines are medium-grade, and the market price fluctuates greatly. Generally, it is in the range of 20,000 to 50,000 low-grade spiritual stones. It can increase the probability of foundation building by 30 to 60%, and is the most widely used in the cultivation world.

    The Five-Path Pattern and the Six-Path Pattern are top-grade, with a market price starting at 100,000. The effect of assisting foundation building is more than 70%, but they are relatively rare. Especially the Six-Path Pattern, which has a price but no market, and usually appears at auctions.

    As for top-quality elixirs with seven or more lines, they are probably extinct in the entire Yan country's cultivation world.

    Anyway, Su Mu has never heard of it, let alone seen it. Even the lowest level entry elixir, the highest quality is only six lines.

    This shows how attractive a five-marked Foundation Establishment Pill is to him.

    In addition, Qi Zizuo, an older foundation-building monk who has lived for more than two hundred years, must have accumulated a lot of wealth.

    However, there are many hidden dangers.

    For example, he was afraid that his life would be useless if he took the Foundation Establishment Pill.

    Becoming a Taoist couple with Qi Yunxi, in the eyes of others, is almost like having "I have the Foundation Establishment Pill" engraved on your face, and your crime of having a jade will be remembered by others.

    With his current level of cultivation at the sixth level of Qi refining, he couldn't grasp it at all.

    After some calculations in his mind, Su Mu looked across and was about to refuse again.

    Qi Zizuo, who had been observing the changes in his expression, sent a message first: "Don't worry, this Five-Pattern Foundation Establishment Pill was obtained by chance. Outsiders don't know it. I have prepared two more Three-Pattern Patterns for you and Xi'er. If someone comes to your door, just give them out."

    Su Mu met his eager eyes, thinking of how the other party had taken care of him over the years, and now that he was dying, he begged again and again, and for a moment he couldn't bear it and was extremely entangled.

    Qi Zizuo smiled and continued: "I have lived for such a long time and have a few trustworthy friends in the sect. I will ask them to take care of you. You don't need to worry too much."

    Su Mu hesitated for a moment, unable to transmit the voice due to lack of spiritual consciousness. He leaned forward slightly and lowered his voice and said, "Forgive me for the offence. I would like to ask Elder Qi, how much life do you have left?"
